title: PostgreSQL JSONB vs JSON Storage and Operators
realWorldScenario: An analytics logging platform stores heterogeneous event payloads and needs to decide between PostgreSQL's `JSON` and `JSONB` data types.
questionStatement: What are the internal differences between `JSON` and `JSONB` in PostgreSQL? Which operators are used to extract text versus JSON objects?
expectedConcepts: JSON textual representation vs JSONB decomposed binary format
hints: The "B" in JSONB stands for Binary.
